closing.title: The Recap

timeline.heading: 📊 What Gally learned during the journey
timeline.intro: Every one of Camille's interactions was captured. Here's how this data improves the experience for future visitors.

search.consequence: → Gally logs the query and result count. Popular terms rise in autocomplete. Zero-result queries are flagged to enrich the catalog.

display.consequence: → Gally measures each product's impression rate. Products seen but never clicked are flagged to adjust their ranking.

viewCategory.consequence: → The "category" context is remembered for the session. Every following action is automatically attached to it.

viewProduct.consequence: → The product's popularity score increases. Gally uses this signal to rank it higher in similar future searches.

addToCart.event: Camille adds the product to her cart
addToCart.consequence: → Strong conversion signal: the product gets boosted in results. Combined with VIEW:product, it feeds the "Frequently viewed together" recommendations.

order.consequence: → Full loop: products bought together feed the "Frequently bought together" recommendations. Revenue per query lets relevance be optimized by generated revenue.

cost.heading: 💰 First-year cost
cost.gallyNote: Flat fee, not indexed on catalog size or query volume

closing.disclaimer: Order-of-magnitude figures observed on comparable e-commerce search projects — excluding internal costs. To be refined based on the prospect's context.

insights.heading: 📊 What Gally knows
insights.empty: Browse the site to see Gally learn from your interactions.

search.consequence: Popular terms rise in autocomplete. Zero-result queries are flagged.

category.consequence: The category context is remembered. Following actions are automatically attached to it.

display.consequence: Gally measures the impression rate and optimizes the ranking of under-viewed products.

product.consequence: The popularity score increases. These products will rank better in future searches.

cart.consequence: Strong conversion signal: these products are boosted in results and feed the recommendations.

order.consequence: Full loop: feeds the "Frequently bought together" recommendations and revenue optimization.

trackingMeaning.categoryView: Gally logs the visit to category "{{categoryCode}}" — helps analyze which categories draw the most traffic and optimize merchandising.
trackingMeaning.cmsDisplay: Gally logs the impression of {{count}} articles with their position — cms_page is a first-class indexed entity, so editorial content earns the same behavioural signals as products.
trackingMeaning.cmsPageView: Gally logs the article view for “{{title}}” — content engagement feeds the same behavioural signals as product views.
trackingMeaning.productView: Gally logs the product view for "{{sku}}" — feeds the popularity score and personalized recommendations.
trackingMeaning.search: Gally logs the search "{{query}}" ({{count}} results) — improves autocomplete, detects zero-result searches, and refines relevance.
trackingMeaning.display: Gally logs the display of {{count}} products with their position — measures impression rate and optimizes ranking.
trackingMeaning.addToCart: Gally logs the cart addition of "{{sku}}" (×{{qty}}) — strong conversion signal used to boost this product in results.
trackingMeaning.order: Gally logs order #{{orderId}} ({{total}}€, {{count}} item(s)) — completes the loop: products bought together feed the "Frequently bought together" recommendations.
